root_cause.text: Insufficient validation of the embedded INIT chunk length and raw address list length in `sctp_unpack_cookie()`, combined with missing bounds checks in `sctp_raw_to_bind_addrs()`, allowed out-of-bounds reads when processing a malformed COOKIE_ECHO chunk.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds checks in `sctp_unpack_cookie()` ensuring the INIT chunk length (`chlen`) is at least `sizeof(struct sctp_init_chunk)` and that `chlen` and `bear_cookie->raw_addr_list_len` do not exceed the remaining cookie payload. It also adds bounds checks in `sctp_raw_to_bind_addrs()` to verify sufficient data exists for each address parameter header and its length before parsing.
